title: Fix bugs in a Rust calculator module
description: A Rust calculator module has three bugs: division returns floor instead of float division, power uses addition instead of multiplication, and percent_of has dividend and divisor swapped. Fix all three.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the three bugs in src/lib.rs:

1. BUG 1 in divide(): Replace `(a as i64 / b as i64) as f64` with `a / b` for proper float division.
2. BUG 2 in power(): Replace `result += base` with `result *= base` to multiply instead of add.
3. BUG 3 in percent_of(): Replace `(total / part) * 100.0` with `(part / total) * 100.0` to fix the swapped operands.

Run `cargo test` to verify all 6 tests pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
